digest.component_or_area: repository environment bootstrap and Codex agent guidance
propositions: Codex sessions invoke ambient Ruff and miss mypy even though GitHub CI and Claude Code use the repository environment, causing divergence between local and CI quality gates.
The repository must document how Codex sessions bootstrap and activate the virtual environment using the same workflow as Claude Code to prevent ambient tooling masking repository failures.
make lint and make typecheck must exit zero when run with the correct worktree PATH configuration prepending .venv/bin, aligning with the authoritative local development setup documentation.
AGENTS.md guidance must instruct Codex to prepend the current worktree .venv/bin on every command, eliminating the need to change linter/type-checker implementation or reformat unrelated files.
